name: Ancient City of Nessebar
description: Nessebar sits on a small rocky peninsula jutting into Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, joined to the mainland by a narrow isthmus. Settled over 3,000 years ago, first by Thracians and then by Greeks, it still has an ancient acropolis, a temple of Apollo and medieval Byzantine churches. Wander its lanes to see charming 19th-century wooden houses with overhanging upper floors.
